findings.explanation: Ordinary lights being extinguished become physically disappearing lights.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと共に外に出る
findings.explanation: Saber’s presence in Shirou’s departure is omitted.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s state didn’t change after dinner’s cleanup
findings.evidenceJa: 夕食の片付けから桜の様子は変わらなかった
findings.governingReading: Sakura had remained that way since the dinner cleanup
findings.explanation: A continuing state beginning with cleanup is shifted to a comparison made after cleanup.

findings.highlight: And on top of that, she didn’t want me to walk her home
findings.evidenceJa: そのくせ俺に家まで送られるのは嫌がって
findings.governingReading: despite that, she resisted having me walk her home
findings.explanation: The contrast between Sakura’s sickly condition and refusal is changed to simple accumulation.

findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえに連れられて帰っていった
findings.governingReading: she went home accompanied by Fuji-nee
findings.explanation: The English adds compulsion to Taiga’s escort.

findings.highlight: It seems likely that other Masters are over there
findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターが潜んでいる可能性はあちらの方が高そう
findings.governingReading: the likelihood of other Masters lying hidden seems higher over there
findings.explanation: The comparison between patrol areas and the Masters’ concealment are lost.

findings.highlight: Saber is right in front of me, looking angry
findings.evidenceJa: むっとしたセイバーの顔
findings.governingReading: Saber’s annoyed face is directly before me
findings.explanation: Saber’s contained displeasure is strengthened into anger.

findings.governingReading: I let my guard or attention slacken
findings.explanation: Shirou’s admission that his attention relaxed becomes generic mental vacancy.

findings.highlight: There is a slight distortion of the ley-line
findings.evidenceJa: 地脈の流れに僅かな支障が起きています
findings.governingReading: a slight impediment has arisen in the flow of the spiritual ley lines
findings.explanation: A disturbance in the flow becomes a deformation of the ley line itself.

findings.highlight: We may be able to defeat one tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜中に一人減らせる
findings.governingReading: we may be able to reduce their number by one tonight
findings.explanation: Saber’s blunt prospect of eliminating a Master is softened into an ordinary defeat.

findings.evidenceJa: 五体満足ならばおいそれと敗れることはありません
findings.governingReading: so long as my body is whole, I will not be defeated so readily
findings.explanation: Saber’s explicit condition that her body is intact disappears.

findings.highlight: We do not know their Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーの宝具が何であるか
findings.explanation: The owner of the unknown Noble Phantasm is blurred into a plural pronoun.

findings.highlight: Masters are people we have to stop, not kill
findings.evidenceJa: マスターは止めるものであって倒すものじゃない
findings.governingReading: Masters are people to stop, not defeat
findings.explanation: Shirou’s refusal to defeat other Masters is sharpened into a narrower refusal only to kill them, weakening his stated policy.

findings.highlight: They should be ready for it
findings.evidenceJa: その終わりは受け入れている筈だ
findings.governingReading: they must have accepted the end that comes with fighting as Masters
findings.explanation: Shirou’s grave statement about accepting one’s end becomes a vague claim of preparedness.
The named district in the patrol choice is generalized.
